# Age over size

`customer_support.heu.queue_management.age_over_size` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> Backlog age tells you more than backlog size.


## The heuristic

**Backlog age tells you more than backlog size.**


_Why:_ Size is largely a function of arrival rate and is often out of your control by the time you read it. Age is a function of your own work-selection order and is entirely yours. A large young queue is a busy day; a small old queue is a broken policy.
